ei.subject: 2025년 10월 고1 모의고사
ei.title: 30번 — Gen Z의 가치 기반 금융 결정

fullPassage: While convenience and technology are crucial, they are not the only factors driving Gen Z's financial decisions. This generation is incredibly values-driven, and they want to bank with institutions that match their personal beliefs and values. Transparency is vital. Gen Z is skeptical of large corporations and institutions that lack accountability. They have grown up in a world where information is freely available, and they expect complete transparency from the brands they support. Banks, for example, must clearly communicate fees, terms, and conditions, as well as how they handle customers' data. Moreover, ethical banking practices are more important than ever. Gen Z cares about the environment, social justice, and the ethical implications of their financial decisions. They are interested in sustainable investing, supporting businesses that match their values, and ensuring that their money is not being used to fund beneficial practices. Banks that offer socially responsible investment opportunities and are committed to environmental sustainability will attract Gen Z's attention.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'crucial'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 편의성과 기술이 매우 중요하지만, 그것들이 Gen Z의 금융 결정을 이끄는 유일한 요인은 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② essential: 필수적인, 매우 중요한 — crucial의 동의어
❌ ① trivial(사소한) — 반의어
❌ ③ optional(선택적인) — 반의에 가까움
❌ ④ harmful(해로운) — 무관
det.tip: crucial = essential = vital = critical

det.korean: Gen Z는 책임감이 부족한 대기업과 기관에 대해 회의적이다.

❌ ① doubtful(의심하는) — 동의어
❌ ② suspicious(의심스러워하는) — 동의어
❌ ④ cynical(냉소적인) — 유사어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①일치하다 ②회의적인 ③자유롭게 ④비밀(→transparency 투명성)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ secrecy(비밀)는 원문의 transparency(투명성)와 정반대. Gen Z는 '완전한 투명성'을 기대함
❌ ①②③ 원문 일치

det.korean: 그들은 __________ 투자에 관심이 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ sustainable: 동사 sustain → 형용사 sustainable. 명사 investing을 수식할 형용사 필요
det.tip: sustain(지속하다) → sustainable(지속 가능한) → sustainability(지속 가능성)

questions.passage: While convenience and technology are crucial, they are not the only factors driving Gen Z's financial decisions. This generation is incredibly values-driven, and they want to bank with institutions that match their personal beliefs and values. Transparency is vital. Gen Z is skeptical of large corporations and institutions that lack accountability. They have grown up in a world where information is freely available, and they expect complete transparency from the brands they support. Banks, for example, must clearly communicate fees, terms, and conditions, as well as how they handle customers' data. Moreover, ethical banking practices are more important than ever. Gen Z cares about the environment, social justice, and the ethical implications of their financial decisions. They are interested in sustainable investing, supporting businesses that match their values, and ensuring that their money is not being used to ____ beneficial practices. Banks that offer socially responsible investment opportunities and are committed to environmental sustainability will attract Gen Z's attention.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fund beneficial practices
det.analysis:
✅ ① fund harmful practices: 앞의 environment, social justice 보호 흐름에 자연스럽게 연결. 해로운 관행에 자금이 쓰이지 않기를 원함
❌ ③ fund beneficial practices — 유익한 관행을 피할 이유 없음(원문 오류 포인트)
❌ ② buy luxury goods — 무관
❌ ④ hire employees — 무관
det.tip: not ~ fund harmful = 해로운 것에 자금 지원하지 않음. 30번 기출 정답 포인트와 동일
